hidden.description: Workspace names left out of the bar, comma separated (a scratchpad's shelf, for instance). Lower case is not required. The workspace you are on is still drawn while you are on it.
hidden.label: Hidden workspaces

hide_empty.description: Draw nothing for a workspace with no windows. The focused workspace is always drawn.
hide_empty.label: Hide empty workspaces

dot_size.description: Diameter of a dot, in logical pixels.
dot_size.label: Dot size

dot_color.description: Palette role name (tertiary, secondary...) or hex value for the dots.
dot_color.label: Dot color

focused_color.description: Palette role name or hex value for the pill of the workspace you are on.
focused_color.label: Focused workspace color

focused_text_color.description: Palette role name or hex value for the name inside the focused pill.
focused_text_color.label: Focused workspace text color

font_size.description: Font size of the focused workspace name. 0 uses the bar default.
font_size.label: Font size

max_label_chars.description: Truncate the focused workspace name to this many characters. 0 shows it whole.
max_label_chars.label: Maximum label characters

gap.description: Space between the dots and the pill, in logical pixels.
gap.label: Gap
